nodes.description: Storage slot keccak256("PROXIABLE") = 0xc5f16f0fcc639fa48a6947836d9850f504798523bf8c9a3a87d5876cf622bcf7 holding the implementation (logic) contract address used for delegatecall.
Contract-level declaration event myEvent(bytes) used to emit the raw return data of the constructor delegatecall.

constructor(bytes constructData, address contractLogic) public: stores the logic address with inline assembly sstore and immediately delegatecalls contractLogic with constructData, then requires success.
fallback() external payable: inline assembly sloads the logic address, copies calldata and delegatecalls the logic, forwarding return data or reverting; no access control on the caller.
Inline assembly sstore(0xc5f1..., contractLogic): unguarded low-level write of the implementation address into the PROXIABLE storage slot.
contractLogic.delegatecall(constructData): delegatecall to a caller-supplied address with caller-supplied calldata during construction, executing arbitrary code in the proxy's storage context.
delegatecall(gas(), contractLogic, 0x0, calldatasize(), 0, 0) with contractLogic read from storage and calldata fully attacker-controlled.
bytes memory constructData: calldata payload forwarded verbatim to the implementation's delegatecall in the constructor.
address contractLogic: implementation address that becomes both the sstore value and the constructor delegatecall target.
bool success: outcome of the constructor delegatecall, checked by require(success, "Construction failed").
bytes memory __ : raw return data of the constructor delegatecall, emitted via myEvent.
let contractLogic := sload(0xc5f1...): assembly local holding the implementation address read from storage in fallback().
let success := delegatecall(...): assembly local holding the delegatecall result switched on in fallback().

edges.reason: constructor body reaches the inline-assembly sstore that persists the logic address without any validation.

contractLogic parameter flows into the sstore of the PROXIABLE slot, setting the delegatecall target without access control.
contractLogic parameter is used directly as the delegatecall target, allowing arbitrary code execution in the proxy context.
constructData parameter is passed as the calldata payload of the delegatecall, letting the caller choose what code path runs.
delegatecall returns the success flag stored in local success for the require check.
delegatecall returns the raw bytes captured in local __.
delegatecall return data is emitted through the myEvent event.
the PROXIABLE storage slot is the destination written by sstore, fixing which implementation the proxy will use.
fallback sloads the PROXIABLE storage slot into the assembly local contractLogic.
the storage-read logic address becomes the delegatecall target with no zero-address or trust validation.
fallback() forwards every unauthenticated call and its calldata to the delegatecall of the stored logic contract.
the delegatecall result is stored in the assembly local success used by the switch statement.
